title: Casey's Gives Back to Veterans with Hope For The Warriors
summary: Casey's is proud to support veterans & their families in our communities. We thank our guests and team members for generously supporting us in this endeavor!
body_markdown:
It's hard to believe that we're nearing the end of fall and the holiday season will soon be underway. Like many people, the holidays get us thinking about ways to do something for others, as well as ways we can give back to our guests and communities.


Many of our guests, their families, and their neighbors have served our country. We are thankful for that great service.


Last November, with the help of our generous guests, Casey's donated over $1.2 million to help veterans and their families. This year, we're looking to make even more of an impact through our partnerships with[Hope For The Warriors](https://www.hopeforthewarriors.org/) .


When you visit Casey's from November 4th through December 1st, you can help us salute all service members, past and present, and their families by rounding up your purchases at the register or donating through orders placed online.


## Hope For The Warriors


Since 2012, Casey's has worked with[Hope For The Warriors](http://www.hopeforthewarriors.org/) (HOPE) to help service members and their families restore a sense of self, family and hope through comprehensive support programs.


“Supporting those who have served and sacrificed for our country is core to who we are at Casey’s, and every year, I’m incredibly proud of how our team members, guests and partners answer the call to stand with our military community,” said Darren Rebelez, president and CEO of Casey’s, and a veteran of the United States Army. “This campaign turns that gratitude and generosity into meaningful action for veterans, active-duty service members and their loved ones.”


Over the last eight years, Casey's General Stores has raised over $12 million to support those who serve their communities.


##


## Stories of HOPE


### Building a New Career Path: Hector D.


Following military service and a difficult battle with addiction, Hector faced the challenge of rebuilding his life and finding a new direction. The transition to civilian life can be overwhelming, especially when paired with recovery and uncertainty about the future.


Through HOPE's career coaching services, Hector received individualized guidance designed to help him identify his strengths, clarify his goals, and navigate the job search process. He also received support translating his military experience into skills valued by civilian employers. With the right coaching and encouragement, Hector was able to create a path forward and pursue meaningful employment with renewed confidence.


### Reclaiming Health and Endurance: Daniel M.


When Daniel was diagnosed with cancer, he faced one of the most difficult challenges of his life. Following a bone marrow transplant, Daniel spent 100 days in the hospital recovering. Throughout this journey, Team HOPE continued to check in, offering encouragement and reminding him that he was not alone.


Daniel's determination paid off. Just months after leaving the hospital, he completed a half marathon with Team HOPE. Later, he returned to the marathon course alongside his wife, reclaiming the endurance sports and physical activity that had been an important part of their lives together for decades.


Daniel's story is a testament to resilience, perseverance, and the power of having a supportive community by your side through every stage of recovery.


###


## Salute a Vet in Your Community


The brave men and women who protect and serve our great nation come from all walks of life. These heroes are parents, children, grandparents, friends, neighbors, coworkers and important leaders in our communities. During this season of giving,[Casey's](https://www.caseys.com/community/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=caseysblog&utm_campaign=veteranspartnerships) encourages you to consider saluting a veteran near you by participating in our annual campaign to support military communities.


---


#### You can help


Round up this November! Be Here for Veterans by shopping at Casey's and rounding up your purchase.


[See more ways to help](https://www.caseys.com/community/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=caseysblog&utm_campaign=veteranspartnerships)
